summary: P57 stopped fail-closed in phase P57-02 at the immutable outbound-request boundary. The cumulative ledger preserved P54 requests 1-5 and recorded 27 new attempts (11 provider-reached, 16 preconnect failures, zero quota). Official TikTok oEmbed resolved one Creative Center stable video ID to official creator, title and canonical identity without authentication, proving a viable per-URL verifier, but the candidate was not scuba-relevant and was not retained. With only 13 attempts remaining, ten final records still require at least 20 official per-URL verifications across two independent live rounds before further discovery, so completion would exceed the limit of 40. No adapter, fixture, Registry V3, MTC, Analysis handoff, PR or merge was created. The exact final implementation head 6eecaa4208b67aea29781d90d87ecf12ddb55868 passed YAML parsing, Python compilation, targeted P57/Foundation checks and the complete 56/56 deterministic corpus; all seven protected blobs remain identical to baseline fc611d408146830b47f9220ae85d04645512d4da.
